Sunrise Communications AG keeps people in touch — with an integrated customer portal, CRM system, Microsoft Outlook, Office & SharePoint
Learn more
Integration with Doxis
Improved customer service
Benefit from a 360° view of your customers across all systems — ERP, CRM, email and much more
End-to-end digital processes
Pave the way for end-to-end processes with information combined from all company systems
Create value in daily work
Don't waste time on repetitive tasks like data capture & filing or creating eFiles
Doxis has huge integration capabilities and the flexibility to enhance process efficiency."
Dirk Kuhlmann, IT Demand Management, Phoenix Contact GmbH & Co. KG
Get to know Doxis live!
In a live demo or at your place of business.
Arrange a Live Demo
360° view of projects & business partners
Systematically combine information from Microsoft Office & business applications and benefit from a complete overview to expedite decision-making and the provision of information.
Mitigate legal risks
Automate document filing from all your company systems and effortlessly prove compliance with retention periods and data protection requirements.
Familiar work environment
Continue working as normal in the standard Office applications or leading ERP, CRM, HR systems etc. and use the intuitive, integrated ECM functions.
Efficient, error-free digital processes
Put an end to delays caused by switching between media & systems and benefit from secure, automated processes.
 These companies have already integrated Doxis with their systems 
Connect what belongs together
ERP, accounting, CRM or HR — structured data can be managed with a wide range of systems. Doxis puts your invoices, contracts, CAD drawings and emails together in the right business context. You can see and access all documents associated with a transaction any time at the touch of a button.
Multiple systems — one ECM
With the universal, vendor-independent Doxis connectors for ERP, CRM etc. you can integrate any of your applications. This enables you to create the integration scenario that fits your interface needs. Generic and specific interfaces, content federation services and add-ins enable you to create a variety of integration scenarios, from indirect to seamless integration. The Doxis Viewer displays more than 300 file formats — without ever having to install the original application.
ERP
From order entry to invoice review: With Doxis integration, you can can find all documents related to transactions in ERP and accounting. You can increase efficiency with automated inbound invoice processing.
More about invoice processing with Doxis »
CRM
Emails, contracts and customer data? Doxis integrates them into your business processes. This way, sales, service and marketing teams can access all information in customer eFiles, also while working remotely.
More about Doxis customer eFile »
CAD
With Doxis CAD Manager, you archive drawings, models and approval processes transparently and audit-proof. Users can access them even without CAD.
More about the Doxis CAD Manager »
HR
Integrate your HR system with Doxis: Personnel and applicant data plus the related documents are bundled into HR eFiles in Doxis in a centrally secure and uniform way.
More about Doxis HR eFile »
Email & Groupware
Emails from partners, customers and employees in addition to documents from groupware: Doxis automatically assigns them to the right context and process. Smart add-ins enhance your applications with ECM functions.
More about email archiving with Doxis »
 Best practice 
Sunrise offers its telecommunications customers a first-class service. It's all thanks to the end-to-end management of all customer information from the customer portal, CRM system, Microsoft Outlook, Office and SharePoint — in combination with Doxis.
Read now 
Integration the way you want it
You define the integration depth. Generic and specific interfaces, content federation services and add-ins provide you with full flexibility:
Add missing functionality
Round out your leading systems with missing functions such as audit-proof archiving: Users can access these functions via the familiar interface, for example, when filing documents using Microsoft Office, or automatically when archiving SAP data. Doxis imports information from the document or filing context  as metadata.
Seamlessly integrated
Users work entirely in familiar interfaces, using the ECM extensions as if they were native to SAP or other specialized applications. With Doxis, you’ll find that cumbersome switching between systems and media, poor process support and redundant data records are all things of the past.
Event condition action (ECA)
Automate your processes across system boundaries. For example, Doxis automatically creates the proper Doxis eFiles for new ERP or CRM data records. In addition, Doxis automatically extracts information from the source systems and imports it — without any programming (ECA).

Are you running SAP, Microsoft or Salesforce? Perfect! Learn all about vendor-specific and certified interfaces of Doxis:
Full integration in SAP
